Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [page/3/Text/11] SWB: SWB was measured by five different scales for evaluating cognitive and emotional dimensions: (1) The Philadelphia Geriatric Center Positive Morale Scale (PGCMS) (Lawton, 1975) comprises 17 items with a 4-point response scale and an index based on the average score of all responses. (2) The Life Satisfaction Index-A (Neugarten et al., 1961) with 20 items, [page/3/Text/12] a 5-point response scale and an index based on the average score. (3) The Satisfaction with Life Scale (Carmel, 2001a) based on the average score of responses to the degree of satisfaction (on a 5-point scale) with physical health, mental ability, relations with friends, relations with the family, ability to help the family, and life in general. ... (5) Geriatric Depression Scale (GDS) (Sheikh & Yesavage, 1986; Zalsman, Aizenberg, & Sigler, 1998) comprises 15 items with 'Yes' and 'No' responses, and an index based on the sum of scores.
